criteria.name: Object-Oriented Design
criteria.description: Proper use of classes, encapsulation, and access modifiers

levels.label: Excellent
levels.description: Complete OOP design with proper encapsulation, private data members, public methods, constructors, and getters/setters where appropriate

levels.label: Good
levels.description: Good use of classes with minor encapsulation issues or missing some access modifiers

levels.label: Needs Improvement
levels.description: Basic class structure but poor encapsulation, public data members, or missing key OOP principles

levels.label: Poor
levels.description: No OOP design, procedural code, or all code in main function

criteria.name: Core Functionality
criteria.description: Implements deposit, withdrawal, and balance operations correctly

levels.label: Complete
levels.description: All operations work correctly: deposit adds money, withdraw removes money, balance displays correctly, maintains owner name

levels.label: Mostly Complete
levels.description: Most operations work with minor bugs in edge cases or one operation partially working

levels.label: Partial
levels.description: Some operations work but significant bugs in deposit, withdraw, or balance tracking

levels.label: Minimal
levels.description: Most or all operations don't work correctly

criteria.name: Error Handling and Validation
criteria.description: Validates inputs and handles errors appropriately

levels.label: Comprehensive
levels.description: Prevents negative deposits/withdrawals, prevents overdrafts, validates all inputs with clear error messages

levels.label: Good
levels.description: Handles most error cases but missing some validations or error messages

levels.label: Basic
levels.description: Minimal error handling, some invalid operations allowed, or program crashes on bad input

criteria.name: Code Quality
criteria.description: Code organization, documentation, and naming conventions

levels.label: Excellent
levels.description: Clean code structure, meaningful variable names, proper comments and documentation, multi-file organization for compiled languages

levels.label: Good
levels.description: Good organization and naming with minor issues in documentation or file structure

levels.label: Needs Improvement
levels.description: Poor naming conventions, minimal documentation, or poor file organization

levels.label: Poor
levels.description: No documentation, unclear variable names, or disorganized code
